gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Commanding from the first letter, Oxanium keeps one uniform line and a big-looking lowercase. Noto Sans Gothic hollows out its round forms into generous counters, so a stiff, drawn top meets a softer, rounder text.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Oxanium skims across the line at a single stroke weight, its curves ending in clear daylight beneath a lowercase that looks big. Noto Sans Grantha slips in beneath with tall, flattened bowls that never snag.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Noto Sans Gujarati reads cleanly, its curved strokes stopping short of turning inward and leaving open counters in a, e and s. Oxanium's plotter-pen line up top gives the text a crisp, mechanical edge.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-gond: Oxanium holds a sign-painter's single-stroke width from end to end, and its lowercase looks outsized. Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi cuts its terminals back to leave big gaps, with crayon-tall lowercase strokes.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-gurmukhi: Noto Sans Gurmukhi points its terminals outward like tongs, with ascenders that barely clear the x-height of the lowercase. Oxanium's rounded-wire line up top is what makes the pairing distinctive.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Oxanium stitches its strokes like thread along a path, with curves that end in clear daylight. Noto Sans Hanunoo is the easy half, its lowercase filling most of the height.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Oxanium gives its diagonals the same heft as its stems, so every stroke feels cut from one bar. Noto Sans Hebrew swells the midsection and leaves wide gaps between curve ends and stems.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-hk: Distinctive in its plain constant-width lines, Oxanium sits over Noto Sans HK, whose large lowercase and lifted brush ends stay clean. Paragraphs in it should move along smoothly, without stumbling.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-imperial-ara: Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic points the ends of its c apart like pincers. Oxanium, drawn with a technical pen's line weight, earns its keep when it is large and brief.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-inscriptiona: Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian reads clean, with open eyes on e and a. Page after page, the deep middle band gives text a steady footing, while Oxanium's constant stroke stays up top.
